description: Observed 2026-11-11 on PR #4112 head 2c6bc9bdf: full CI run 43089849237 had succeeded, the single 'CI (text edit)' run 43089851201 was still failed because its refresh was queued behind a runner backlog, and `make pr-rerun PR=4112` answered 'CI run 43089849237 on 2c6bc9bdf succeeded; nothing to re-run'. On #4110, which had two placeholder runs, the same command did re-run the older one as a 'stale suite'. Since #4120 `make pr-arm` waits through this state and the refresh job re-runs every failed placeholder, so the command is rarely needed here; but when the refresh job itself fails or never starts, pr-arm falls back to advising `make pr-rerun`, which then does nothing.
